title: office.decision-ingest request
description: Append answered Orbit decision requests in the followed workspaces to the decision ledgers (specs/decision-precedents.md, Ingesting Orbit decisions). Idempotent by request id and answer time.

since.description: RFC 3339 time: ignore answers applied before it, and closed unanswered requests raised before it. Default: every request Orbit lists.

dry_run.description: Report what would be appended without writing. Default false.
